# stripe_product (Data Source)

Use this data source to get information about a Stripe Product.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the product.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the product is currently available for purchase.
- `created` (Number) Time at which the product was created.
- `default_price` (String) The ID of the default price for this product.
- `description` (String) The product's description.
- `images` (List of String) A list of up to 8 URLs of images for this product.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to a product.
- `name` (String) The product's name.
- `package_dimensions` (Attributes) The dimensions of this product for shipping purposes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package_dimensions))
- `shippable` (Boolean) Whether this product is a shipped good.
- `statement_descriptor` (String) Extra information about a product which will appear on a customer's credit card statement.
- `tax_code` (String) A tax code ID.
- `unit_label` (String) The label for the product's unit of measure.
- `updated` (Number) Time at which the product was last updated.
- `url` (String) The URL of the product.

<a id="nestedatt--package_dimensions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package_dimensions`

Read-Only:

- `height` (Number) Height, in inches.
- `length` (Number) Length, in inches.
- `weight` (Number) Weight, in ounces.
- `width` (Number) Width, in inches.
